protocols: W3C Trace Context through host OpenTelemetry configuration

observation.coverage_basis: In-process Decision and child-span context managers plus explicit recorder methods and the shipped CrewAI adapter. The SDK emits protected-by-default OpenTelemetry metadata; it does not materialize Activity Envelope v2.

authentication.credential_handling: The SDK accepts no Fabric service credential; exporter credentials belong to the host-configured OpenTelemetry exporter.

correlation_limitations: Propagation across network or process boundaries depends on host OpenTelemetry instrumentation.
Caller-reported operations are complete only when application code records them.

verification_evidence.claim: Proves the import surface excludes runtime-control, evaluation, judge, policy, authorization, and escalation modules.
Exercises recorder decision identity, correlation, lifecycle, and metadata-only capture behavior.
Qualifies the exact recorder wheel and source distribution against file and API allowlists.

known_blind_spots: Uninstrumented application branches, subprocesses, and off-the-shelf agent internals are not visible.
Tenant and agent identifiers are validated assertions, not cryptographically bound workload identity.
Raw LLM or tool content can be opted into per call; the SDK has no pre-egress redactor, so protected export requires Fabric Node or an equivalent customer-controlled processor.
The SDK emits OpenTelemetry and does not materialize Activity Envelope v2, privacy assertions, delivery receipts, durable retention, or immutable evidence.
